rdfs:label: logoutEndpoint
rdfs:comment: The URL at which a user can log out of a given Solid server (legacy server metadata, predates Solid-OIDC; OIDC providers expose end_session_endpoint instead).
notes: Counterpart to `urn:solid:loginEndpoint`. Legacy (NSS-era) server metadata, not specific to an OpenID provider. Solid-OIDC providers expose logout via OIDC discovery (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`'s `end_session_endpoint`) instead.

examples.title: Server with login and logout endpoints

history.note: Definition: legacy server logout URL, not OIDC-specific.
